from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull

def hull_stats(grid, mark, out):
 H,W=grid.shape
 pts=np.array([(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r,c]==mark])
 hull=ConvexHull(pts)
 verts=pts[hull.vertices]
 print('vertices',verts)
 # hull eq: normal*x+off<=0 interior
 eq=hull.equations
 inside=[]; off=[]
 for r in range(H):
  for c in range(W):
   if grid[r,c]==mark: continue
   vals=eq[:,:2]@np.array([r,c])+eq[:,2]
   if np.all(vals<=1e-8): inside.append((r,c))
   if out[r,c]==2: off.append((r,c))
 print('hull interior count',len(inside),'2 count',len(off),'overlap',len(set(inside)&set(off)),'2 outside',len(set(off)-set(inside)),'hull unfilled',len(set(inside)-set(off)))
 return set(inside),set(off),verts
